query.description: 측정 항목 추가 (InsertExecuteMultiple, 번호는 시퀀스 ET_ITEM_SEQ)
query.commandtext: INSERT INTO TQP_GDS_ET_ITEM (ET_ITEM_SEQ, FACTORY, DEVICE_ID, ITEM_NAME, PARA_NAME, COND_VALUE, CHAIN_NAME, CHAIN_NAME2, UNIT, TEST_NO, DISPLAY_ORDER, CREATE_USER, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_USER, UPDATE_TIME) VALUES (ET_ITEM_SEQ.NEXTVAL, :factory, :device_id, :item_name, :para_name, :cond_value, :chain_name, :chain_name2, :unit, TO_NUMBER(:test_no), TO_NUMBER(:display_order), :create_user, SYSDATE, :update_user, SYSDATE)

query.description: Device 의 측정 항목 목록 (등록 순)
query.commandtext: SELECT ET_ITEM_SEQ, ITEM_NAME, PARA_NAME, COND_VALUE, CHAIN_NAME, CHAIN_NAME2, UNIT, TEST_NO, DISPLAY_ORDER FROM TQP_GDS_ET_ITEM WHERE FACTORY = :factory AND DEVICE_ID = :device_id ORDER BY DISPLAY_ORDER, ET_ITEM_SEQ

query.description: Limit 설정 화면: 측정 항목이 있는 Device 목록 (Factory 별)
query.commandtext: SELECT DEVICE_ID, COUNT(*) AS ITEM_COUNT FROM TQP_GDS_ET_ITEM WHERE FACTORY = :factory GROUP BY DEVICE_ID ORDER BY DEVICE_ID

query.description: Para Setup: 등록 Parameter 가 있는 Device + 공정 목록 (2026-10-14)
query.commandtext: SELECT DEVICE_ID, TEST_PROGRAM, COUNT(*) AS PARA_COUNT FROM TQP_GDS_ET_ITEM WHERE FACTORY = :factory AND TEST_PROGRAM IS NOT NULL GROUP BY DEVICE_ID, TEST_PROGRAM ORDER BY DEVICE_ID, TEST_PROGRAM

query.description: Para Setup: Device + 공정의 등록 Parameter + 대표 Chain / GDS Chain + Spec 요약 + 값 있는 파일 수. Spec 은 새 키(ITEM_NAME)와 예전 키(헤더 원문 대문자)를 둘 다 본다 (2026-10-14)
query.commandtext: SELECT I.ET_ITEM_SEQ, I.ITEM_NAME, I.HEADER_TEXT, I.MEAS_TYPE, I.PARA_NAME, I.COND_VALUE, I.CHAIN_NAME, I.CHAIN_NAME2, I.FORCE_LEG, I.FORCE_LEG2, I.CHAIN_TYPE, I.UNIT, I.TEST_NO, I.DISPLAY_ORDER, I.USE_FLAG, I.REG_SOURCE, I.REG_FILE_NAME, I.REMARK, R1.REP_CHAIN_NAME AS REP_CHAIN_NAME, R2.REP_CHAIN_NAME AS REP_CHAIN_NAME2, NVL(V1.CHAIN_NAME, L1.GDS_CHAIN_NAME) AS GDS_CHAIN_NAME, NVL(V2.CHAIN_NAME, L2.GDS_CHAIN_NAME) AS GDS_CHAIN_NAME2, CASE WHEN SN.ITEM_NAME IS NOT NULL OR SO.ITEM_NAME IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS HAS_SPEC, CASE WHEN SN.ITEM_NAME IS NOT NULL THEN SN.LOWER_LIMIT ELSE SO.LOWER_LIMIT END AS LOWER_LIMIT, CASE WHEN SN.ITEM_NAME IS NOT NULL THEN SN.UPPER_LIMIT ELSE SO.UPPER_LIMIT END AS UPPER_LIMIT, CASE WHEN SN.ITEM_NAME IS NOT NULL THEN SN.ENABLE_FLAG ELSE SO.ENABLE_FLAG END AS ENABLE_FLAG, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT V.SRC_FILE_SEQ) FROM TQP_GDS_ET_VALUE V WHERE V.ET_ITEM_SEQ = I.ET_ITEM_SEQ) AS FILE_COUNT, NVL(I.UPDATE_USER, I.CREATE_USER) AS UPDATE_USER, NVL(I.UPDATE_TIME, I.CREATE_TIME) AS UPDATE_TIME FROM TQP_GDS_ET_ITEM I LEFT JOIN TQP_GDS_ET_REP_CHAIN R1 ON R1.FACTORY = I.FACTORY AND R1.DEVICE_ID = :g1 AND R1.TERMINAL_NAME = I.CHAIN_NAME LEFT JOIN TQP_GDS_ET_REP_CHAIN R2 ON R2.FACTORY = I.FACTORY AND R2.DEVICE_ID = :g2 AND R2.TERMINAL_NAME = I.CHAIN_NAME2 LEFT JOIN TQP_GDS_ET_CHAIN_LINK L1 ON L1.FACTORY = R1.FACTORY AND L1.DEVICE_ID = R1.DEVICE_ID AND L1.REP_CHAIN_NAME = R1.REP_CHAIN_NAME LEFT JOIN TQP_GDS_ET_CHAIN_LINK L2 ON L2.FACTORY = R2.FACTORY AND L2.DEVICE_ID = R2.DEVICE_ID AND L2.REP_CHAIN_NAME = R2.REP_CHAIN_NAME LEFT JOIN TQP_GDS_CHAIN_VER V1 ON V1.FACTORY = L1.FACTORY AND V1.DEVICE_ID = L1.DEVICE_ID AND V1.CHAIN_SEQ = L1.CHAIN_SEQ AND V1.IS_CURRENT = 1 LEFT JOIN TQP_GDS_CHAIN_VER V2 ON V2.FACTORY = L2.FACTORY AND V2.DEVICE_ID = L2.DEVICE_ID AND V2.CHAIN_SEQ = L2.CHAIN_SEQ AND V2.IS_CURRENT = 1 LEFT JOIN TQP_GDS_ET_LIMIT SN ON SN.FACTORY = I.FACTORY AND SN.DEVICE_ID = I.DEVICE_ID AND SN.TEST_PROGRAM = I.TEST_PROGRAM AND SN.ITEM_NAME = I.ITEM_NAME LEFT JOIN TQP_GDS_ET_LIMIT SO ON SO.FACTORY = I.FACTORY AND SO.DEVICE_ID = I.DEVICE_ID AND SO.TEST_PROGRAM = I.TEST_PROGRAM AND SO.ITEM_NAME = UPPER(I.HEADER_TEXT) WHERE I.FACTORY = :factory AND I.DEVICE_ID = :device_id AND I.TEST_PROGRAM = :test_program ORDER BY I.DISPLAY_ORDER, I.ITEM_NAME

query.description: Para 등록 검사: Device + 공정의 등록 Parameter 이름 / 원문 / 단위 (2026-10-14)
query.commandtext: SELECT ET_ITEM_SEQ, ITEM_NAME, HEADER_TEXT, UNIT FROM TQP_GDS_ET_ITEM WHERE FACTORY = :factory AND DEVICE_ID = :device_id AND TEST_PROGRAM = :test_program

INSERT INTO TQP_GDS_ET_ITEM (ET_ITEM_SEQ, FACTORY, DEVICE_ID, TEST_PROGRAM, ITEM_NAME, HEADER_TEXT, PARA_NAME, COND_VALUE, MEAS_TYPE, CHAIN_NAME, CHAIN_NAME2, CHAIN_TYPE, FORCE_LEG, FORCE_LEG2, UNIT, TEST_NO, DISPLAY_ORDER, USE_FLAG, REG_SOURCE, REG_FILE_NAME, CREATE_USER, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_USER, UPDATE_TIME) VALUES (ET_ITEM_SEQ.NEXTVAL, :factory, :device_id, :test_program, :item_name, :header_text, :para_name, :cond_value, :meas_type, :chain_name, :chain_name2, :chain_type, :force_leg, :force_leg2, :unit, TO_NUMBER(:test_no), TO_NUMBER(:display_order), 'Y', :reg_source, :reg_file_name, :create_user, SYSDATE, :update_user, SYSDATE)

UPDATE TQP_GDS_ET_ITEM SET USE_FLAG = :use_flag, REMARK = :remark, UPDATE_USER = :update_user, UPDATE_TIME = SYSDATE WHERE FACTORY = :factory AND DEVICE_ID = :device_id AND TEST_PROGRAM = :test_program AND ITEM_NAME = :item_name

query.description: Parameter 삭제 전 확인: 저장된 측정값 수 (2026-10-14)
query.commandtext: SELECT COUNT(*) AS VALUE_COUNT FROM TQP_GDS_ET_ITEM I JOIN TQP_GDS_ET_VALUE V ON V.ET_ITEM_SEQ = I.ET_ITEM_SEQ WHERE I.FACTORY = :factory AND I.DEVICE_ID = :device_id AND I.TEST_PROGRAM = :test_program AND I.ITEM_NAME = :item_name
DELETE FROM TQP_GDS_ET_ITEM WHERE FACTORY = :factory AND DEVICE_ID = :device_id AND TEST_PROGRAM = :test_program AND ITEM_NAME = :item_name
